object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Export a document whose heading and requirement both have figures, with a figure program that draws only the requirement's figure, one that fails to run, and none at all. Expected: the figure program is run once over the exported figures, in outline order; the objects reported as not drawn are exactly those whose figures the figure program didn't produce, in outline order, and a drawn figure is never reported; with no figures the figure program isn't run.
